findings.desc: CHK-001/CHK-002 evidence command npm run test:bare-gate-gitroot-cwd is not wired into any lattice validate aggregator path (same gap as B-2856 gitroot-cwd-routing). The smoke runs correctly when invoked directly and all 6 must intents have passing logic_test evidence. However, the test is invisible to the default validate battery (test:e2e does not include it), meaning a future refactor of verifier.ts or evaluateStoryDirConfigInsideGitRoot could silently break the fix without lattice validate catching it. Recommend adding the smoke to a validate-run aggregator (or at minimum documenting the manual run requirement in a waiver note on the evidence records) so regression is caught automatically. This is a systemic pattern across wrapper-root smokes in this codebase; this finding is scoped to B-3990 but a broader wiring story would close the pattern-wide gap.
findings.dismissReason: Out-of-scope systemic gap, not a B-3990 defect. The smoke is real and passing (with a negative-check that catches the old projectRoot behavior); all 6 must intents have passing logic_test evidence. Wiring smokes into the validate battery requires editing the ROOT package.json test script (test=npm run test:e2e only) — outside B-3990 execution boundary (packages/main only) and a pattern-wide concern: every wrapper-root smoke (B-198c storydir suite, B-2856 gitroot-cwd-routing, plus authority/evidence smokes) shares this exact gap, and both B-198c and B-2856 reached DONE with it. Closing it belongs in a dedicated infra story that aggregates all such smokes into the validate run; tracked as follow-up, not forced into this narrow cwd fix.
